title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Rate Card: Interest on Member Appeals to Out-of-Network Plans Paying First
content:
**Rate card — Insurance Coverage & Claims, member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays first.** The first-plan member appeal's annual interest rate follows the age of the claim in calendar days from its filing date to today.

| Claim age | Annual interest rate |
|---|---|
| More than 90 days (first-plan aged days) | 15 percent (first-plan aged rate) |
| More than 45 days (first-plan standing days), not more than 90 | 10 percent (first-plan standing rate) |
| 45 days or fewer | 6 percent (first-plan base rate) |

## Boundaries

- 91 days: 15 percent; 90 days: 10 percent.
- 46 days: 10 percent; 45 days: 6 percent.

## Hypothetical readings

A claim filed 30 days ago carries 6 percent a year, one filed 75 days ago 10 percent, and one filed 300 days ago 15 percent.
